def classify_problem(categories, statement):
    category_matches = {}
    
    for category in categories:
        name, _, words = category
        word_count = len(words)
        matches = 0
        for word in words:
            matches += statement.count(word)
        category_matches[name] = matches
    
    max_matches = max(category_matches.values())
    suggested_categories = [name for name, matches in category_matches.items() if matches == max_matches]
    
    return suggested_categories

def main():
    N = int(input())
    categories = []
    for _ in range(N):
        category_info = input().split()
        name = category_info[0]
        W = int(category_info[1])
        words = category_info[2:]
        categories.append((name, W, words))
    
    statement = []
    for _ in range(int(input())):
        statement.extend(input().split())
    
    suggested_categories = classify_problem(categories, statement)
    for category in sorted(suggested_categories):
        print(category)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
